name: Liddle Tots II Teen Summer Camp
description_short: A summer day camp run by Liddle Tots II Teen, a DCYF-licensed childcare center in Warwick, RI. Programs for each age group mix sports, cooking, arts and drama, team games, crafts and science, with weekly themes and field trips. Camp runs Monday to Friday, 7 AM to 5:30 PM.

sources.note: Drafted by the listing tool from this page
Summer camp page: program list, 'LICENSED BY DCYF'. Hours (7AM-5:30PM) are on the homepage.
'Summer Camp - $260.00'; tuition due the Friday before the following week; registration fee $35 first child, $15 each additional; 10% sibling discount (full time); DHS certificates accepted.
